subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` be accepted as a supported Plugin SDK contract in `channel-ingress-runtime`, or should this refactor keep that conversion internal until a broader channel-turn API is approved?
rationale: The implementation deliberately creates a new externally importable SDK function; code review can assess its narrowness, but only maintainers can choose the intended long-term external API boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK mapper
options.body: Accept the decision-only mapper in the experimental ingress runtime and retain the shared WhatsApp turn-plan refactor after validation is green.

options.title: Keep conversion internal
options.body: Avoid adding the public SDK export and use a core-private or WhatsApp-local conversion until maintainers define the broader channel-turn API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK mapper
recommendation.body: Accept the decision-only mapper in the experimental ingress runtime and retain the shared WhatsApp turn-plan refactor after validation is green.

likelyOwner.reason: As the member who authored the proposed API and WhatsApp migration, they are the best available person to clarify the intended contract and incorporate the chosen direction.
